name: Thorum
description: Thorum was a minor jungle planet located in the Thorum system of the Vendusii sector in the Mid Rim Territories of the galaxy. It had a substantial Crimson Dawn presence. Calda was the planet's largest city and a business hub. The Hammers syndicate were also located on the world.
